look_here_first: Think thicket-forming plum: slender often thorny branchlets, narrow serrate leaves, white spring flowers before or with leaf-out, and red to yellow plum-like drupes.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: white spring flowers before or with leaf-out

lookalikes.differences: Compared with P. mexicana, Chickasaw plum is usually more thicket-forming and thorny with narrower leaves and a more shrubby/suckering habit.
